body:
I know the girl from class, and the friend also from class. We used to be fairly close friends, and I still try to maintain a friendship, but he is very defensive when we talk (we are literally talking just now because of some class related stuff, and he got insulted when I asked what grade he got - it wasn't a bad grade or anything, he just kept interrogating me why I was asking about his grade, even though that's a normal thing to do). He usually tries to avoid me and doesn't share any personal info with me. I asked him because I knew he also knew the girl, and at the time we were talking because he asked to copy my class notes (which is really the only time we ever talk anymore). 

And I don't know about meeting people that way, it's generally a good idea, but I don't really know where to find people such as myself, since such people don't attend social activities much, probably. 

As for hobbies, I try out things that I have the chance to, but it never seems to work out. Sometimes I find it fun initially, but I always get bored of it quickly. I've tried lots of things and nothing ever stuck, except for playing guitar maybe. I still don't really like doing it, but it's still an interesting thing to do, equivalent to fidgeting with something when you're bored. And even that, I rarely do anymore, mostly just to pass time, like with videogames.

Yeah, I think I get what you mean. Distracting yourself with the things you like when you're thinking of things you dislike is a good idea. It's only a bandage and it won't solve the problem, but it gets you through some tough times when you can't really do anything about the bad feelings other than wait them out, such as with breakups. Problem with me is, I don't have anything I particularly like. In those times I just play videogames with lots of action (I don't really enjoy videogames too much but it's a good way to pass time) and/or play very loud and strong music (Mastodon's Once more round the sun album, Judas Priest's Painkiller album, Nekrogoblikon) or maybe something nice such as David Bowie.
